offensive.name: Shatterpoint
offensive.description: Cold does not break things. It waits for them to become breakable.

tiers.text: The damage becomes Cognitive Cold and gains +2 dice. A creature carrying any Frost Stack takes one additional die.
+4 dice. A creature with 2 or more Frost Stacks has vulnerability to this damage.
+6 dice. Against a creature that is Restrained, Frozen, or Paralyzed, this effect deals maximum damage.
+8 dice. A creature reduced to 0 hit points shatters — it cannot be revived by anything short of Greater Restoration, and every creature within 10 feet takes 4d10 cold damage from the burst.
Suspend a dying creature (at 0 HP but not dead) in magical ice. They do not make death saving throws until the ice thaws at the end of your next turn.
Use this effect as a reaction when a creature drops to 0 HP — encasing them for up to 1 minute. They are stable and cannot be targeted while frozen.
A willing creature may be frozen in time for up to 1 hour. While encased they are immune to all effects but also cannot act, speak, or be detected by magical means.

Once per long rest, cast this effect on yourself — while frozen you are invulnerable and regain 1d4 hit dice per hour spent in stasis. You may set a condition to thaw automatically (a specific sound, time elapsed, or touch from a named creature).
Gain resistance to cold damage for 1 minute. While active, your Concentration cannot be broken by cold damage.
Once per long rest, when you are hit by cold damage, you may instead gain temporary HP equal to the damage that would have been dealt.
You gain immunity to the Frightened condition and cannot be Charmed while standing on ice or frozen terrain.
When reduced to 0 HP, you may instead shatter into ice — becoming a frozen statue immune to all damage for 1 minute, then reforming at half HP as the frost around you reconstitutes your body.

control.name: Glacial Grasp
control.description: Your frost clings with oppressive force.

tiers.text: When you deal cold damage, the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
On a failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained by ice until the end of their next turn.
The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw to break free, or the Restraint persists until the end of your next turn (maximum 1 minute of Concentration).
The ice spreads — one additional creature of your choice within 10 feet of the original target must also save or be Restrained by the same creeping frost.

control.name: Permafrost Curse
control.description: Chill the soul as well as the body.

tiers.text: If a creature fails a saving throw against your effect, they cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn.
The cursed creature also suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and Constitution saving throws for 1 minute.

penalty.disadvantage: Dexterity saving throws and Constitution saving th

tiers.text: Creatures that fail are vulnerable to cold damage for 1 minute. Repeat Constitution save at end of each turn to end early.
Mark a creature with Cursed Ice — if they die while marked, they shatter into frozen fragments and cannot be revived by any means short of Wish or divine intervention.

creation.name: Glacial Creation
creation.description: What you shape from cold, cold keeps.

tiers.text: Your creations are slick ice. Creatures crossing a Structure treat it as difficult terrain; a creature that touches or strikes one takes 1d6 cold damage. Objects deal +1d6 cold on a hit.
Your creations are immune to cold and resistant to bludgeoning damage. A creature that starts its turn touching a Structure gains 1 Frost Stack.
Structures grant three-quarters cover. A Construct's attacks apply 2 Frost Stacks, and it may Freeze a creature it grapples.

Glacial permanence: your creations ignore fire effects of 5th level or lower, and a destroyed Structure or Construct shatters for 6d10 cold damage in a 20-foot radius (Constitution save for half), leaving Frozen Ground for 1 minute. In a region of perpetual cold, a Construct may instead be an Icebound Denizen, a native elemental of that region.

utility.name: Rime Whisper
utility.description: Cold is patient. It waits, and it remembers.

tiers.text: Freeze up to a 10-foot cube of water; chill or preserve food for a day; raise steps or handholds of ice on a surface you touch.
Walk on water by freezing it beneath your feet; shape a lens of clear ice that lets you see 300 feet as if 30.
Place a willing creature in cryo-stasis for up to 8 hours — no aging, no bleeding, no progress of poison or disease.
Freeze a moment: capture a scene you can see in a pane of ice that replays it once when broken, or entomb a nonmagical object so that it cannot decay, rust, or be opened without countering.

complementEffects.name: Deep Freeze
complementEffects.description: Cold doesn't kill in an instant — it builds.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target gains 1 Frost Stack. At 2 Frost Stacks their movement speed is reduced by 15 feet. At 3 Frost Stacks they are Restrained until they succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC equals your Verum DC) or receive fire damage. Frost Stacks fade after 1 minute without additional cold exposure.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Each application of Deep Freeze now applies 2 Frost Stacks instead of 1.
Level 11+: At 3 Frost Stacks the target is Paralyzed rather than Restrained, and stacks persist for the full duration of the encounter.

complementEffects.name: Frost Veil
complementEffects.description: A thin shell of ice forms between you and the world's heat.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally of your choice within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus. While these temporary HP remain, the ally has resistance to fire damage.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Temporary HP increases to twice your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus, and the ally also gains resistance to cold damage.
Level 11+: You may choose two allies to receive this benefit, and each is additionally immune to being set on fire or affected by environmental heat while the temporary HP persists.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, the ground in a 10-foot radius around them flash-freezes — becoming difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or be knocked prone.

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The frozen terrain persists for 1 minute, and creatures that enter it for the first time on a turn must make the Dexterity save or be knocked prone.
Level 11+: The radius increases to 20 feet, and creatures that are knocked prone are also Restrained until they succeed on a Strength check against your Verum DC.
